description: Provision a Google Cloud Logging LoggingLogSink via Config Connector. Fields mirror the logging.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 LoggingLogSink spec.

usePartitionedTables.description: Whether to use BigQuery's partition tables. By default, Logging creates dated tables based on the log entries' timestamps, e.g. syslog_20170523. With partitioned tables the date suffix is no longer present and special query syntax has to be used instead. In both cases, tables are sharded based on UTC timezone.

description.description: A description of this sink. The maximum length of the description is 8000 characters.

bigQueryDatasetRef.description: DatasetRef is a reference to a BigQueryDataset. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally-managed BigQueryDataset resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/datasets/{{datasetID}}".

name.description: The name of a BigQueryDataset resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a BigQueryDataset resource.

loggingLogBucketRef.description: LoggingLogBucketRef is a reference to a LoggingLogBucket. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed LoggingLogBucket resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/buckets/{{bucketID}}".

kind.description: The kind of the LoggingLogBucket resource.

name.description: The name of a LoggingLogBucket resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a LoggingLogBucket resource.

pubSubTopicRef.description: PubSubTopicRef is a reference to a PubSubTopic. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed PubSubTopic resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/topics/{{topicID}}".

name.description: The name of a PubSubTopic resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PubSubTopic resource.

storageBucketRef.description: StorageBucketRef is a reference to a GCP StorageBucket. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed StorageBucket resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/buckets/{{bucketID}}".

name.description: The name of a StorageBucket resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a StorageBucket resource.

disabled.description: If set to True, then this sink is disabled and it does not export any log entries.

exclusions.description: Log entries that match any of the exclusion filters will not be exported. If a log entry is matched by both filter and one of exclusion's filters, it will not be exported.

disabled.description: If set to True, then this exclusion is disabled and it does not exclude any log entries.

filter.description: An advanced logs filter that matches the log entries to be excluded. By using the sample function, you can exclude less than 100% of the matching log entries.

name.description: A client-assigned identifier, such as "load-balancer-exclusion". Identifiers are limited to 100 characters and can include only letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, and periods. First character has to be alphanumeric.

filter.description: The filter to apply when exporting logs. Only log entries that match the filter are exported.

folderRef.description: Immutable. The folder in which to create the sink. Only one of projectRef, folderRef, or organizationRef may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of a folder, when not managed by Config Connector. The recommended format is "folders/{folderID}".

includeChildren.description: Immutable. Whether or not to include children organizations in the sink export. If true, logs associated with child projects are also exported; otherwise only logs relating to the provided organization are included.

organizationRef.description: Immutable. The organization in which to create the sink. Only one of projectRef, folderRef, or organizationRef may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The 'name' field of an organization, when not managed by Config Connector.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. The project in which to create the sink. Only one of projectRef, folderRef, or organizationRef may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

uniqueWriterIdentity.description: Whether or not to create a unique identity associated with this sink. If false (the default), then the writer_identity used is serviceAccount:cloud-logs@system.gserviceaccount.com. If true, then a unique service account is created and used for this sink. If you wish to publish logs across projects, you must set unique_writer_identity to true.
